# Replication of the 2021 notebook (generated by scripts/replicate_original.py)

## Person-by-person comparisons

- gan2021 vs sup2021: gan2021 better for 3 of 16 people; mean difference -0.008; Wilcoxon p = 0.0577
- gan2021 vs avg_beat: gan2021 better for 1 of 16 people; mean difference -0.111; Wilcoxon p = 0.00058
- sup2021 vs avg_beat: sup2021 better for 1 of 16 people; mean difference -0.103; Wilcoxon p = 0.00101

## Is the discriminator doing anything? (gan2021, last 50 training steps)

- D loss: mean 0.4034, SD across runs 0.0832
- SD of D's output on a real window: mean 0.2329 (instance norm on the 1-channel output fixes it to |gain| for every input)
- generator adversarial loss 0.2892, supervised 0.1520, 'cycle' 4.35e-05

## Can it draw a flat line?

- output SD per 1 s window on real SCG: 0.853; on near-zero noise input: 0.838; real ECG target: 0.981

r_vs_avg_beat_true_r: correlation between a method's output and the average beat pasted at the true R-peaks. prd_notebook is the notebook's formula (x100 inside the square root).
